titleAr: استيراد جهات اتصال من ملف CSV
titleEn: Import contacts from CSV (with consent attestation)

en: How do I upload a customer list?

steps: Prepare CSV with a phone column (name and tags optional), up to 10 MB
Tick consent ONLY if you can prove it
Start import; see Recent files and rejected rows
edgeCases: Import never undoes an opt-out or overwrites consent
gaps: Column mapping supported by API; UI has no mapping step (verify)
assistantNote: the consent tick is a legal attestation: the merchant must tick it themselves
